verdict.rationale: Ramp supports scheduled workflows only indirectly. The AI Agents guide positions the CLI for "scripted/scheduled workflows", with `--agent` JSON output, `--no-input` and client-credential agent login. agents.ramp.com offers "Long-running access — for background agents that run on a schedule." The scheduling itself must come from an external runner such as cron or CI, and Ramp's own automation (reminders, rules-based routing) is event- or rule-driven rather than user-scheduled. missing for 10: a native scheduler or recurring-job feature in Ramp, documented cron/schedule configuration for workflows, hands-on corroboration of scheduled agent runs.
